declaration.ref: hand-written for kit-daily-tasks against tasks-v1 and standup-v1; no field is copied from a stored report

tasks-minimal.json.proves: a briefing with no domains is still a briefing

tasks-extra-domain.json.proves: a partial run, a domain the board does not draw, an extra item field, an extra payload key, and coverage sources all pass

tasks-with-html.json.proves: markdown, an urgent work item, a queue entry updated '12d', and an HTML edition pass together

tasks-failed-run.json.proves: a failed run is stored, so a missed day has a revision

standup-weekday.json.proves: a weekday standup is non-blank markdown under the briefing's period

tasks-unknown-priority.json.reason: priority is one of urgent, today, soon, later

tasks-missing-sections.json.reason: sections is required, even when it is empty

tasks-queue-updated-in-words.json.reason: a queue entry's age is whole days, like 4d

tasks-domain-is-a-list.json.reason: a domain is an object holding items and a queue, not a bare list

tasks-unknown-envelope-key.json.reason: the envelope is closed; extra fields belong in the payload

tasks-blank-title.json.reason: a title of spaces is blank once trimmed

standup-blank-markdown.json.reason: a standup of whitespace says nothing
